original.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services, and any custom setup leveraging that label must use the strimzi.io/pod-name label instead.

decision.reason: [ev-4fdefdd841ec] says Strimzi removed the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external listener Services, and tells users to use the `strimzi.io/pod-name` label instead. That supports change type "removed", with the strimzi.io/pod-name label as replacedBy. No subject family is meant for labels on resources the operator manages. The free-form protocol-behavior name "statefulset-pod-name-label" uses the evidence's own key words and is unambiguous, so it is an acceptable mapping. Confidence is low because choosing that family is my interpretation, not something the evidence states.
